tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background of the billing screen. Warm paper, never pure white, so the screen does not glare over a long shift.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards: the bill list, total panel, payment tiles, receipt.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, keypad keys, the selected bill line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between bill rows only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, stepper buttons and unselected tiles (3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All main text, prices and the grand total on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: unit price, item code, hints. Reads 5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Fresh green. The one main action per screen (Pay, Done, Add), the scan-OK tick, savings figures on surface-200.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-500.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Green tint: savings strip, newly-scanned row flash, success banner.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Green text on brand-100 and surface-200 ("You saved ₹45").

tokens.name: sun-400
tokens.usage: Sunny yellow. Highlights the grand total and the change-to-return box. Use once per screen.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on sun-400 in both themes (dark text, never white).

tokens.name: sun-100
tokens.usage: Soft yellow: hold-bill and weigh-item notices, with ink text.

tokens.name: tomato-600
tokens.usage: Tomato orange. Remove item, cancel bill, errors. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text on tomato-600.

tokens.name: tomato-100
tokens.usage: Warning and error banner background.

tokens.name: tomato-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text on tomato-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Calm blue. UPI/Card payment, info notes, and the focus ring (3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text on sky-600.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Info banner and digital-receipt QR panel.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text on sky-100.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: Grand total and change-to-return only. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, one short question or instruction.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Line totals in the bill list. Tabular figures so columns line up.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Product names in bill rows, tile labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Scan the next item or type its code.
styles.usage: Instructions and banners. Never smaller on the cashier screen.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Unit price, qty labels, button sub-labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Printed receipt fine print only. Not on the cashier screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between keypad keys, chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bill row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between bill rows and panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Total panel padding, gap between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer screen margin on the counter display.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, keypad keys, bill rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, payment tiles, total panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Qty stepper, status pills.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target for any button or key. A 10-year-old's finger hits it first time.

tokens.name: tap-main
tokens.usage: Height of the one main action (Pay, Done).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards resting on surface-100.
